lessons.symptom: The primary Prepare action initially fell below the first iPhone SE viewport even though a scroll-based Widget assertion passed
lessons.cause: The action was placed after scroll content instead of being kept in a stable reachable area
lessons.proposed_change: Require a first-viewport visibility assertion for the primary action on the smallest supported phone, not only scroll-until-visible
lessons.regression_check: At 320pt width and 568pt height with 1.3x text, the primary action is present without framework exceptions and the actual iPhone SE screenshot shows it above navigation

lessons.symptom: A stopped but unreviewed recording was persisted yet could not resume its review state after controller recreation
lessons.cause: Persistence loaded sessions but did not reconstruct the workflow state from isReviewed=false
lessons.proposed_change: Add an explicit rehydration check for every durable intermediate state in the functional-review checklist
lessons.regression_check: A new controller restores the pending review, keeps it out of formal archive, and permits keep, resume or delete

lessons.symptom: Removing an index before deleting its private audio could make a failed deletion impossible to retry from the UI
lessons.cause: The two-step delete operation temporarily discarded the only durable pointer before the fallible file deletion completed
lessons.proposed_change: For local private-data deletion reviews, require a fault-injected partial-failure test that preserves a retry path
lessons.regression_check: Injected file deletion failure keeps both index and audio; a later retry removes both
